subcategory_text: Problematic data actions, likelihoods, and impacts are used to determine and prioritize risk.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: RA-3, PM-16 (Threat Awareness Program)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 ID.RA-05 (asset risk prioritised)
implementation_examples: Combine the catalogue of problematic data actions with likelihood and impact assessments to produce a prioritised privacy-risk register
Use a documented risk-rating method (e.g., qualitative or semi-quantitative) so the prioritisation is reproducible and auditable
Link each prioritised risk to the data actions, data elements, and categories of individuals it touches
assessment_objectives: Determine whether a documented risk-rating method is used
Determine whether likelihood and impact are estimated for each problematic action
Determine whether the prioritised register links risks to the underlying data actions and elements
Determine whether the rating method supports comparison across risks and across processing activities
